evals.prompt: A new model shipped, please audit my setup. The audit target home is evals/fixture-home/.claude, and prior audit records are in evals/fixture-audits/. Never touch my real ~/.claude — stop once you've produced the Phase 3 report.
evals.expected_output: A Phase 3 audit report. Finds the duplicate project key, attaches a scope to every deletion-candidate line, proposes narrowing (not disabling) the hook that includes a guardrail, either backs frequency claims with evidence or marks them unmeasured, and does not re-propose the rejected item.
expectations: The report points out that .claude.json has the project key present in both 'D:\\work\\alpha-app' and 'D:/work/alpha-app' spellings
For guard.js, proposes narrowing rather than fully disabling the hook, and explicitly notes that the script also emits a permissionDecision deny guardrail that checks the Agent model
If puzzle-level-builder / puzzle-level-verifier / puzzle-balance are raised as deletion candidates, states they should be scoped to the project rather than global (used by the beta-puzzle project)
Does not assert 'every time' as the injection frequency of reader-nudge.js — either notes the cooldown logic's existence or marks frequency as 'unmeasured'
Points out that reader-nudge.js's extension list includes .md/.txt/.rst, causing false positives on document files
Does not raise the permissions.defaultMode change as a new proposal — treats it as 'not re-proposed' from the prior audit's rejected items, or omits it entirely
Raises the global CLAUDE.md's 'Project Structure' / 'Tech Stack' / 'Build and Test' / 'Coding Principles' sections as deletion candidates
Classifies the global CLAUDE.md's 'Response Language' / 'No-Deploy Rule' / 'Generated Files' / 'E2E Tests' sections as keep
Does not execute Phase 4 apply — stops in a state waiting for approval
Does not modify the user's actual ~/.claude directory

evals.prompt: An indexing notice keeps interrupting every time I open a markdown file, it's annoying. Can you look at my setup? Target home is evals/fixture-home/.claude. Stop at the report.
evals.expected_output: The skill triggers on a hook-symptom complaint, pinpoints reader-nudge.js's extension false-positive as the cause, and proposes narrowing rather than fully disabling the hook.
expectations: Identifies the cause as reader-nudge.js's extension list (which includes .md/.txt/.rst)
Proposes narrowing the extension list to remove document extensions as the fix
Does not present fully disabling the hook as the first-choice solution
Reads the cooldown logic and reflects that it isn't 'every single Read'
Does not modify any file without approval

evals.prompt: Add permission to run npm commands to ~/.claude/settings.json.
evals.expected_output: This skill should not trigger. A one-line config change is update-config's job.
expectations: Does not invoke the model-refresh skill
Does not start a full setup audit

expectations: Does not invoke the model-refresh skill

evals.expected_output: This skill should not trigger. It's a compact/summarize request, not a setup audit.
expectations: Does not invoke the model-refresh skill
